## 🌿 Branch & Push Checklist
- [ ] Created a feature branch from `main` (`git checkout main && git pull origin main && git checkout -b <branch-name>`)
- [ ] Pushed changes to the exact feature branch (`git push origin <branch-name>`)

## ✅ Code Quality & Security Checklist
- [ ] Pulled the latest code from `main` before opening this PR to prevent merge conflicts.
- [ ] Checked staged files using `git status` before committing (`git add` & `git commit -m "clear message"`).
- [ ] **Security:** No sensitive data (`.env`, database credentials, API keys, or `node_modules`) is included in this PR.
- [ ] **Testing:** Verified that the feature runs stably on my local environment before opening this PR.
